## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] The suite still passes on a machine with **no Blender** installed
- [ ] Any new test was **seen to fail** against the broken state, for the stated reason
- [ ] No new test is hidden behind a module-level skip that would stop it running in CI
- [ ] Any render path asserts an output postcondition — exit code 0 is not proof of a frame
- [ ] No silent fallbacks or swallowed errors added
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` for any user-facing change
- [ ] Updated README/docs if tool signatures or configuration changed
